## Why it matters

SLUB Dresden's digital collections bring together manuscripts, maps, photographs, newspapers, music, and other primary sources from Saxony and beyond.

Its breadth makes it useful for regional and transregional research, especially when work requires visual sources, printed matter, and manuscript material in one place.
